system.description:
You soothe a target's suffering and pain by making their mind unaware of it while also raising their tolerance for pain. Select up to 3 willing creatures within range. Target creatures gain 2d6+5 Temporary Hit points which last for the next 10 minutes.

Additionally, you are able to remove one Mental condition gained as a result of jutsu of C-Rank of lower.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the temporary hit points by 1d6 and the rank of mental condition you can remove by one.
